cat > rosterkit/notices.py <<'EOF'
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def _format_notice(student: Student, days: List) -> str:
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    unit = "day" if len(days) == 1 else "days"
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {len(days)} {unit}: {dates}."


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Build a short notice listing the student's absent days in date order."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(m.student_id != student.student_id for m in marks):
        raise ValueError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = sorted(m.day for m in marks if m.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to report")
    return _format_notice(student, days)
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.models import Mark

STUDENT = Student("1001", "Thistle", "Bram", "A")


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 4), "absent"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 3), "present"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks),
            "Bram Thistle missed 2 days: 2026-09-02, 2026-09-04."
        )

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("2002", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
EOF

commits.message:
Add parent absence notices

Parents need a short written record of the days a student missed. The helper rejects marks from another student and refuses to write a notice when there are no absences, so a wrong or empty notice never goes out.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
